validation_rules: Heartbeat worker_id/claim_id/command_id/lease_epoch MUST exactly match one ACTIVE claim.
heartbeat_sequence MUST increase strictly for the same claim epoch.
observed_at MUST be >= lease_start and <= lease_expiry.
Heartbeat from an older lease_epoch cannot extend or validate a replacement claim.
Heartbeat acceptance may advance the claim heartbeat deadline only within the existing lease_expiry; extending lease_expiry itself requires an explicit lease-renewal mutation.
A missing heartbeat after heartbeat_deadline makes the ACTIVE claim ineligible for execution until stale-lease recovery.
